text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their 
skills began once again this year. As for 
Almond Eye—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It appeared... It's really 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The rare Kyumaru capsule toy! Got it on my 
first try!
choice_data_list:
Oh, even though it went completely 
terribly last year...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it...?! The Kyu-maru magnet lying on 
the beach is just so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up really is what matters! 
With this momentum, I'm definitely going 
to win the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, speaking of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Blast! You're training already?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! I'm the first one here! 
'Cause, 'cause—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"I get to fight alongside Ai again! I 
gotta become way more awesome than Boo was 
before!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right, Kiseki!? Kiseki's doing her best 
too, ya know~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, this won't do. With this development, 
it'll just end up the same... I must be 
more thorough—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah! U-Um... Ai-chan. I...—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Just like last year, I wanna 
play with everyone again!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
During one of our breaks, next time we'll 
do a special combo move—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry! I can't make it this 
time...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it's reckless, I want to give 
it my all!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ah!! Boo wants to go too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Both of you are bursting with 
motivation!
choice_data_list:
Kiseki seemed like she was really brooding 
over it, though...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, she said she wanted to do her 
best! So you've got to do your best too. 
It'll be all right!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then! My regimen for today was 
just a light massage, right?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Shall we get started at a leisurely pace?
choice_data_list: Is it really okay to take it slow?
Is it okay to take it slow?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First, I gotta shake off the race 
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I can still grow 
stronger, right? —With your training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then this time... let's take it easy and 
proceed naturally without pushing 
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just like a rolling Kyu-maru!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the intense... or maybe not? 
Summer training camp began!
